correctness.rationale: The exact threshold-two quotient uses three capped populations per graph part and updates the actual initial-class colour tags. A complete 2187-class enumeration proves F^19=F^7, only periods 1,3,12, a sharp seven-update witness, the 50 symbolic period-twelve classes and the exact 12 period-three classes. Class-to-labelled multinomial weights prove the N3 formula and N12 coefficient formula; balanced asymptotics follow by isolating signatures with one 222 side. All three included scripts were replayed; direct labelled-state enumeration independently verifies seven finite examples, without being mistaken for an infinite proof. Risk is reliance on the transparent finite exhaustive lemma, independently inspectable as source code.

value.rationale: The natural operation of adjoining a universal vertex to K_{m,n} changes the possible periods and settling clock sharply. The theorem gives a complete infinite-family period restriction, exact transient cutoff, sharp existence thresholds, full period-three labelled basin formula, exact computable period-twelve basin formula and an exponentially small but polynomially enhanced rare-cycle law. These are natural dynamical invariants, not an arbitrary parameter slice or routine fixed-point count.
